name: cartridge-traits-gpt2-v54
command: HF_HOME=/pub/wagnera3/hf TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE=1 HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1 /opt/env/bin/python -m model_trainer.cli.cartridge_trait_sweep --plan gpt2-traits --corpus /pub/wagnera3/mi/traits/corpus --device cuda --out /pub/wagnera3/mi/traits/results/gpt2-traits-v54.json

experiment.compared_against: the published steering-vector account of dispositional composition, run here as its own arm at matched trait counts on this same base and these same pairs
experiment.precondition: the solo cell runs FIRST and the run is refused if its expression gain does not clear its own seed spread -- the 7B rung of the corpus arc failed at exactly that step and every retention computed beside it was a division artefact
experiment.deviation_from_recorded_grid: solo, n2 and n4 with untrained-composed and cross controls; the diverse-companion, base-LoRA and crowd-invariance families are NOT run here. Those three repair composition, and the question they answer is only askable once a naive interference number exists to repair.
